files.purpose: Explicit catalog of supported authoritative documents with stable IDs, source paths, and projection target paths.
Control form using strictly enumerated boolean doc selectors to request reading projections.
Submission payload for the worker to provide the complete ordered seed vector.
Execution status tracking document reader progress without exposing raw truth seeds.
Workflow-owned state recording current active documents and expected seeds.
Trusted workflow-only script to project authoritative documents, generate CSPRNG seeds, verify evidence, and manage state transitions.
GitHub Actions workflow to handle doc generation on selector commit and exact seed verification on evidence commit.
files.content:
name: Truth Reader Verification

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'truth_reader/selector.json'
      - 'truth_reader/evidence.json'
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  truth-reader-cycle:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Detect Changed Files
        id: diff
        run: |
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          echo "changed=$CHANGED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q 'truth_reader/evidence.json'; then
            echo "evidence_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "evidence_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q 'truth_reader/selector.json'; then
            echo "selector_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "selector_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Verify Evidence
        if: steps.diff.outputs.evidence_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          node scripts/truth_reader.js --verify
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add truth_reader/
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "[skip ci] Truth reader PASS: atomic cleanup"
            git push
          fi

      - name: Generate Projections
        if: steps.diff.outputs.selector_changed == 'true' && steps.diff.outputs.evidence_changed != 'true'
        run: |
          node scripts/truth_reader.js --generate
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add truth_reader/
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "[skip ci] Truth reader: projections generated"
            git push
          fi
